title: Okta Organization Security Posture
description: Security posture metrics collected from an Okta organization. A metric the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result artifact records why.
comment: Optional fields are gated by collected_at_level: fields marked x-epack-level audit are present at audit and internal; fields marked internal are present only at internal.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

collected_at_level.description: Collection level this artifact was produced at. Levels are cumulative: audit is a superset of trust, internal of audit.

mfa_coverage.description: Percentage of users with any MFA factor enrolled

mfa_phishing_resistant.description: Percentage of users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2, U2F, or Okta FastPass)

per_factor_type.description: Enrolled-user count per active factor type

factor_type.description: Okta factor type in lowercase, such as push, webauthn, sms, email, or token:software:totp.

enrolled_users.description: Number of non-deprovisioned users with at least one active factor of this type.

mfa_disabled_users_count.description: Count of non-deprovisioned users with no active MFA

total_count.description: Users other than deprovisioned ones: the population of every user percentage

password_expired.description: Percentage of users with expired passwords

locked_out.description: Percentage of users currently locked out

inactive.description: Percentage of users inactive for 90+ days

inventory.description: Per-user inventory. Login is the only identifier; profile attributes beyond login are excluded. Capped at 50000 (ACTIVE-first, login-asc).

status.description: The user's Okta status: STAGED, PROVISIONED, ACTIVE, RECOVERY, LOCKED_OUT, PASSWORD_EXPIRED, or SUSPENDED. Deprovisioned users are not listed.

user_type.description: Coarse classification; raw userType never emitted

created_at.description: When the user was created, in RFC 3339 UTC.

last_login_at.description: When the user last signed in, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when the user has never signed in.

last_updated_at.description: When Okta last changed the user's record, in RFC 3339 UTC.

status_changed_at.description: When the user's status last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when Okta reports no status change.

password_changed_at.description: When the user's password last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when Okta reports no password change.

factor_type.description: Okta factor type as Okta reports it, such as push, webauthn, sms, email, or token:software:totp.

status.description: The factor's Okta status. Only active factors are listed.

enrolled_at.description: When the factor was enrolled, in RFC 3339 UTC.

factors.description: The user's active MFA factors. Absent when the user has none.

group_ids.description: Okta IDs of the groups the user belongs to.

inventory_truncated.description: True when the user inventory hit the 50000 cap

total_count.description: Apps: the population of every app percentage

provisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user provisioning

deprovisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user deprovisioning

inventory.description: Per-app inventory (label, name, type, sign_on_mode, status, sso_configured, provisioning_configured). Capped at 5000 (ACTIVE-first, label-asc).

name.description: Name of the Okta app integration the app is built from, such as bookmark or oidc_client.

type.description: App type taken from the sign-on mode: SAML for SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, and WS-Federation, OIDC for OpenID Connect, BOOKMARK, or SWA for every other mode.

sign_on_mode.description: The app's Okta sign-on mode, such as SAML_2_0, OPENID_CONNECT, BOOKMARK, or BROWSER_PLUGIN.

status.description: The app's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

sso_configured.description: True when the app's sign-on mode is SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, or WS-Federation.

provisioning_configured.description: True when the app's features include pushing or importing new users.

inventory_truncated.description: True when the app inventory reached the 5000-app cap and the rest were left out.

inventory_dropped.description: Number of apps left out of the inventory by the cap.

privileged_access.description: Privileged access counts and MFA coverage

privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with any effective Okta admin role

super_admin_count.description: Count of active users with the SUPER_ADMIN role

standing_privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with standing privileged access

privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with any MFA factor enrolled

privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with phishing-resistant MFA

roles.description: The admin roles assigned to the user: the role type for a built-in role, such as SUPER_ADMIN, or the label for a custom role.

role_assignment_source.description: How the user holds their admin roles: direct when each is assigned to the user, group when each comes through a group, or mixed for both.

last_login_at.description: When the user last signed in, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when the user has never signed in.

custom_roles.description: Custom admin roles (Okta Identity Governance feature). Absent, with a not_licensed gap, when Identity Governance is not licensed. Okta's built-in Workflows Administrator role (WORKFLOWS_ADMIN), which Okta lists with the custom roles, is left out.

description.description: The custom role's description in Okta. Absent when it has none.

permission_count.description: Number of permissions the custom role grants. Null, with a gap, when its permissions could not be read.

policy.description: Aggregated security policy settings across all active policies

mfa_required_all.description: Whether MFA is required for all non-deprovisioned users after evaluating active policies and rules

mfa_required_any.description: Whether MFA is required for at least one non-deprovisioned user after evaluating active policies and rules

mfa_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of non-deprovisioned users covered by an MFA requirement

session_lifetime_min_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets a session lifetime
session_lifetime_min_minutes.description: Shortest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

session_lifetime_max_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets a session lifetime
session_lifetime_max_minutes.description: Longest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

idle_timeout_min_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets an idle timeout
idle_timeout_min_minutes.description: Shortest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

idle_timeout_max_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets an idle timeout
idle_timeout_max_minutes.description: Longest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

policies.description: Per-policy summary (name, type, status, priority, rule_count, scope_summary) for sign-on and MFA-enroll policies.

type.description: The policy type: OKTA_SIGN_ON for a global session policy or MFA_ENROLL for an authenticator enrollment policy.

status.description: The policy's Okta status. Only active policies are listed.

priority.description: The policy's priority among policies of its type. Okta evaluates lower numbers first.

rule_count.description: Number of rules in the policy, active or not.

scope_summary.description: group-assigned when the policy names groups or users to include, or everyone when it applies to all users.

priority.description: The rule's priority within its policy. Okta evaluates lower numbers first.

status.description: The rule's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

network_connection.description: The rule's network condition: ANYWHERE, ZONE, or ON_NETWORK. Absent when the rule sets none.

network_zones_included.description: Okta IDs of the network zones the rule's network condition includes.

groups_included.description: Okta IDs of the groups the rule applies to. Absent when the rule names none.

groups_excluded.description: Okta IDs of the groups the rule excludes.

device_managed.description: The rule's managed-device condition, "true" or "false" as Okta reports it. Absent when the rule sets none.

access.description: For a sign-on rule, whether it allows or denies the sign-on: ALLOW or DENY.

require_factor.description: For a sign-on rule, true when it requires a second factor.

factor_prompt_mode.description: For a sign-on rule, when Okta asks for the second factor: ALWAYS, DEVICE, or SESSION.

max_session_lifetime_minutes.description: For a sign-on rule, the longest a session can last, in minutes. 0 means no limit.

max_session_idle_minutes.description: For a sign-on rule, how long a session can stay idle before it ends, in minutes.

persistent_cookie.description: For a sign-on rule, true when the session cookie lasts across browser restarts.

enroll_self.description: For an enrollment rule, when it prompts users to enroll authenticators: CHALLENGE, LOGIN, or NEVER.

managed_device_required.description: Whether any sign-on policy rule requires managed devices

managed_device_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users covered by a managed device requirement

managed_device_required_for_admins.description: Whether all privileged users are covered by a managed device requirement

device_assurance_policies_count.description: Number of device assurance policies defined

policies.description: Per-device-assurance-policy summary (name, platform, status, min_os_version, disk_encryption_required, screen_lock_required, jailbreak_protection).

platform.description: The device platform the policy covers, such as WINDOWS, MACOS, IOS, ANDROID, or CHROMEOS.

status.description: The policy's Okta status. Absent when Okta reports none.

min_os_version.description: The minimum operating system version the policy requires. Absent when it sets none.

disk_encryption_required.description: True when the policy lists at least one accepted disk encryption type.

screen_lock_required.description: True when the policy lists at least one accepted screen lock type.

jailbreak_protection.description: True when the policy includes Okta's jailbreak condition.

groups.description: Group inventory and counts. Omitted at trust. Internal adds per-group member_logins (capped at 200000 total rows; smallest groups truncated first).

total_count.description: Number of groups in the org.

count_by_source.description: Number of groups per Okta group type: OKTA_GROUP for groups created in Okta, APP_GROUP for groups imported from an app or directory, and BUILT_IN for Okta's own groups, such as Everyone.

type.description: The group's Okta type: OKTA_GROUP, APP_GROUP, or BUILT_IN.

source.description: Where the group comes from, taken from its Okta type, so it always equals type.

description.description: The group's description in Okta. Absent when it has none.

member_count.description: Okta's group statistics at audit. At internal, the members read live, so it matches member_logins; a group past the membership budget keeps the statistics.

created_at.description: When the group was created, in RFC 3339 UTC.

member_logins.description: Okta logins of the group's members. A group can have a shorter list when the total cap applies.

inventory.description: One row per group, largest member count first. Capped at 10000 groups.

truncated_memberships.description: True when member lists were cut to stay within 200000 member rows in total. The smallest groups lose their lists first.

truncated_memberships_dropped.description: Number of member rows left out by that cap.

network_zones.description: Network zone inventory and counts. Omitted at trust. Internal adds per-zone gateways/proxies/locations/asns.

total_count.description: Number of network zones in the org.

count_by_type.description: Number of zones per Okta zone type, such as IP, DYNAMIC, or DYNAMIC_V2.

gateway_zone_count.description: Number of zones that list at least one gateway address. Null, with a gap, when any zone's gateways could not be read.

proxy_zone_count.description: Number of zones that list at least one trusted proxy address. Null, with a gap, when any zone's proxies could not be read.

type.description: The zone's Okta type, such as IP, DYNAMIC, or DYNAMIC_V2.

status.description: The zone's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

usage.description: POLICY for a zone that policies can reference, or BLOCKLIST for a zone whose traffic Okta blocks.

gateways.description: The zone's gateway addresses as Okta stores them: single addresses, CIDR ranges, or address ranges.

proxies.description: The zone's trusted proxy addresses, in the same forms as gateways.

locations.description: Locations the zone matches: a country code, or a country and region code such as US-CA.

asns.description: Autonomous system numbers the zone matches.

inventory.description: One row per zone, in the order Okta lists them.

identity_providers.description: Federation identity providers. Omitted at trust. Client secrets, signing keys, and full SSO URLs are never emitted.

total_count.description: Number of identity providers configured in the org.

count_by_protocol.description: Number of identity providers per Okta identity provider type, such as SAML2, OIDC, GOOGLE, or MICROSOFT.

type.description: The identity provider's Okta type, such as SAML2, OIDC, GOOGLE, or MICROSOFT.

status.description: The identity provider's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

issuer_host.description: Host of the identity provider's issuer URL or URN. The full issuer value is not emitted. Absent when Okta reports no issuer.

signing_cert_thumbprint.description: ID (kid) of the signing key Okta trusts for this identity provider.

jit_provisioning.description: True when Okta creates a user from this identity provider the first time they sign in.

group_mapping_count.description: Number of groups Okta assigns to users provisioned through this identity provider.

api_tokens.description: SSWS API tokens. Omitted at trust. Requires a SUPER_ADMIN-level scope; omitted with a gap and a diagnostic on 403. Token secret values are never exposed by the API.

recently_used_count.description: Number of active API tokens used in the 30 days before the run, judged by the lastUpdated time Okta reports for each token.

status.description: The token's Okta status, such as ACTIVE.

created_at.description: When the token was created, in RFC 3339 UTC.

created_by_login.description: Okta login of the user who created the token. Absent when that user is not in the org's user list.

last_used_at.description: When the token was last used, in RFC 3339 UTC, from the lastUpdated time Okta reports for it.

network_zone_scoped.description: True when the token's network condition limits it to one or more network zones.

inventory.description: One row per API token. Token values are never read.

hooks.description: Event and inline hooks. Omitted at trust. Hook auth headers, full URLs, and secrets are never emitted.

event_hook_count.description: Number of event hooks. Null, with a gap, when the event hooks could not be read.

inline_hook_count.description: Number of inline hooks. Null, with a gap, when the inline hooks could not be read.

active_count.description: Number of event and inline hooks whose status is ACTIVE. Null, with a gap, when either kind could not be read.

inactive_count.description: Number of event and inline hooks in any other status. Null, with a gap, when either kind could not be read.

system_log.description: Security-relevant system-log events. Absent at trust. audit: count_by_category over the last 7 days. internal: events[] (event_type, published, actor login+type, targets[], outcome, client_ip, user_agent; no debug-context). Capped at 5000, newest first.

window_days.description: Number of days before the run that the system log values cover. Always 7.

count_by_category.description: Number of security-relevant events in the window per category: user.account, user.session, policy, application, group, system, iam, and security. Counted from the newest 5000 matching events.

event_type.description: The Okta event type, such as user.session.start.

published.description: When Okta recorded the event, in RFC 3339 UTC.

outcome.description: The event's result as Okta reports it, such as SUCCESS or FAILURE. Absent when Okta reports none.

actor_login.description: The actor's alternate ID in Okta, usually a login. Absent when Okta reports none.

actor_type.description: The actor's Okta type, such as User or PublicClientApp.

client_ip.description: The client IP address Okta recorded for the event.

user_agent.description: The client's raw user agent string.

display_name.description: The target's display name in Okta.

type.description: The target's Okta type, such as User, AppInstance, or PolicyEntity.

events.description: The security-relevant events in the window, newest first. Capped at 5000.

truncated.description: True when the events reached the 5000-event cap, so older events in the window are left out.

oldest_event_id.description: Okta ID of the oldest event listed. Present only when the events were truncated.

newest_event_id.description: Okta ID of the newest event listed. Present only when the events were truncated.

org_settings.description: Organization settings. Omitted at trust. audit: subdomain + status + self_service_recovery_enabled. internal: notification_contact_logins[].

status.description: The org's Okta status, such as ACTIVE.

self_service_recovery_enabled.description: True when an active password policy rule allows self-service password reset or account unlock.

notification_contact_logins.description: Okta logins of the org's billing and technical contacts. A contact who is not in the user list is left out.

diagnostics.description: Present when any surface was skipped (missing scope, feature not licensed, transient error). Carries the detail so the customer knows what to grant.

warnings.description: Messages naming each surface or value the run left out and what to grant or enable to collect it.

type.description: For an event hook, the type of its event subscription, such as EVENT_TYPE. For an inline hook, the extension point it handles, such as com.okta.oauth2.tokens.transform.

status.description: The hook's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

subscribed_events.description: Okta event types an event hook subscribes to. Absent for inline hooks.

endpoint_host.description: Host of the URL the hook calls. The full URL is not emitted.

channel_type.description: The hook's channel type, such as HTTP.
